instruction: I have six .png images (pic1.png to pic6.png) saved on the Desktop. Create a presentation with six blank slides, inserting the images in reverse numerical order—pic6.png on the first slide, pic5.png on the second, continuing down to pic1.png on the sixth slide. Each slide should contain only the image without any text boxes or additional elements.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 6 blank slides and inserting images in reverse order (pic6 to pic1). Expected: 6 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. The evaluator checks slide count and image count per slide, but does not verify the specific image order (which would require comparing image content).

llm_judge_reasons: Critical: Cannot verify the primary requirement - images must be in REVERSE numerical order (pic6.png on slide 1, pic5.png on slide 2, etc.). The evaluator only counts images per slide but does not verify WHICH specific images are on which slides.
Coverage gap: Agent could insert images in WRONG order (pic1→pic6 instead of pic6→pic1) and still score 100%
Coverage gap: Agent could insert the SAME image on all slides or random images and still score 100%
Minor: Cannot verify 'only image without text boxes' requirement - evaluator doesn't check if slides contain additional elements like text boxes or shapes besides images
Structural verification works: Correctly verifies 6 slides exist and each has exactly 1 image
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: CRITICAL FIX: Modify getter to extract image filenames or image binary hashes from each slide, then verify the specific images match expected order: slide 1 should have pic6.png, slide 2 should have pic5.png, etc.
Possible approach: Use python-pptx to extract image.blob or image filename from each slide's picture shapes, then compare against expected sequence
MINOR FIX: Add check in getter to count ALL shape types per slide (not just images), then verify each slide has exactly 1 shape total (which must be the image)
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require 'create 6 slides with 1 image each' if image order verification is not feasible
